items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: But one night Herman Stocks got so mad with Harold Oxley, he told him, take that band and get out of here.

ctx.x: He stood -- as he came through the door, came upstairs, he stood against the wall, over -- with his overcoat over his or either topcoat over his arm, dressed to kill, hair gleaming. Good looking man. And he just stood there, listened to the band. He didn't say anything or do anything, he and Herman Stocks. And so, (inaudible) well, he could make us or break us.
But one night Herman Stocks got so mad with Harold Oxley, he told him, take that band and get out of here. (Inaudible) squirmed.
What did he get mad at Oxley for?
